description: Live FedEx shipping options and prices for the items to a destination, the same rates checkout charges. Needs only the country, postal code and, in the US and Canada, the state.

address.description: Where the items ship to. state is required only in the US and Canada (2-letter code). zip is required except in countries without postal codes.

country.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. US, DE, GB

state.description: 2-letter state or province code in the US and Canada (e.g. PA, ON); region name or blank elsewhere

items.description: Products and quantities. Quantity is in the product's selling unit (usually cases).

name: get_shipping_estimate

rates.description: Shipping options, as offered by the carrier

estimated_days.description: Estimated business days in transit, null when the carrier gives none

id.description: Pass this to start_checkout as shipping_rate_id

service.description: Carrier and service, e.g. FedEx Ground

title: Get shipping estimate
